articles.title: ‘Swachhata Didi’ Seriously Injured After 50-Kg Parcel Falls from Bus Roof in Indore, 3 Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A female sanitation worker, popularly known as ‘Swachhata Didi’, was seriously injured in Madhya Pradesh’s Indore after a heavy parcel weighing around 50 kg allegedly fell from the roof of a passenger bus and struck her during duty.

body.html:
A female sanitation worker, popularly known as ‘Swachhata Didi’, was seriously injured in Madhya Pradesh’s Indore after a heavy parcel weighing around 50 kg allegedly fell from the roof of a passenger bus and struck her during duty.

The incident took place on Sunday morning in the Rajmohalla area under the Malharganj police station limits.

The victim, identified as Sunita Bali, was cleaning roads in Ward No. 69 as part of the municipal morning sanitation drive when the accident occurred.

According to officials, a heavy parcel suddenly fell from atop a bus and hit her directly. Local residents rushed to help and immediately shifted her to Verma Union Hospital for treatment.

Doctors said Bali suffered fractures in her shoulder along with injuries to her waist and legs. She remains under medical care.

Following the incident, Bali’s husband, who works as a security guard with the Indore Municipal Corporation (IMC), lodged an FIR with police.

Deputy Commissioner of Police Narendra Rawat said three accused — identified as Sanjay Kachhawa, Akash Bhamar, and Tushar Bhamar — have been arrested in connection with the case.

Police registered a case under Section 109 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) related to attempt to murder, and further investigation is underway.

During questioning, Bali reportedly told police that the parcel slipped from the hands of workers loading luggage onto the roof of the bus before it fell onto her.

After receiving information about the incident, police and local administration officials reached the spot and sealed the warehouse of Indian Transport as part of the investigation.

Municipal corporation officials confirmed that the woman was injured while carrying out sanitation work during the routine morning cleaning operation.

#Indore #MadhyaPradesh #BreakingNews #SwachhataDidi #Accident

articles.title: ‘Spitting on Pizza’ Allegation Sparks Outrage in Noida, Shop Worker Arrested After Viral Video
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A fresh controversy has erupted in Noida after a viral video allegedly showed a pizza shop worker spitting while preparing food at a shop in Sector-22’s Chaura village.

body.html:
A fresh controversy has erupted in Noida after a viral video allegedly showed a pizza shop worker spitting while preparing food at a shop in Sector-22’s Chaura village.

The incident took place in the Sector-24 police station area and involved a pizza outlet named “Pizza Hunt.” The accused has been identified as Muzammil, who reportedly worked at the shop.

According to reports, a video circulating on social media allegedly shows the worker spitting while preparing pizza dough. The clip quickly went viral, triggering outrage among local residents and members of Hindu Raksha Dal.

The organisation’s local representatives claimed they received information about pizzas allegedly being prepared unhygienically and later examined CCTV footage from the shop.

On Sunday, activists reportedly confronted the accused, assaulted him, and later handed him over to police.

During questioning, Muzammil allegedly told police that he was blowing air to remove excess flour while preparing the pizza base and denied intentionally spitting on the food.

Police took preventive action and arrested the accused. Officials said further investigation into the viral video is underway.

The viral clip, reportedly around one minute and 22 seconds long, continues to circulate widely on social media, with claims that the accused repeated the act multiple times.

The incident has once again triggered debate online regarding food hygiene, public behaviour, and vigilantism.

#Noida #BreakingNews #ViralVideo #FoodSafety #Pizza

articles.title: Viral ‘Murga Punishment’ Video Lands Aligarh SI in Trouble, SSP Orders Action
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A sub-inspector posted in Uttar Pradesh’s Aligarh district has been removed from field duty after a video surfaced showing a young man being forced into a “murga” punishment position with a brick placed on his back.

body.html:
A sub-inspector posted in Uttar Pradesh’s Aligarh district has been removed from field duty after a video surfaced showing a young man being forced into a “murga” punishment position with a brick placed on his back.

The incident reportedly took place in Mohalla Kasaiyan under the Vijaygarh police station area and triggered controversy after the video went viral on social media.

According to reports, Sub-Inspector Anil Gupta had gone to the locality on April 10 to serve a court summons. During the visit, he allegedly found some youths playing cards.

The viral video allegedly shows the officer forcing one of the youths to squat in the traditional “murga” punishment posture while placing a brick on his back. Allegations also surfaced claiming that money was taken in exchange for releasing the youth.

Following the circulation of the video, Senior Superintendent of Police Neeraj Jadoun took cognisance of the matter and placed the accused sub-inspector “on line”, removing him from active field responsibilities.

Circle Officer Barla Garvit Singh confirmed that action was initiated after the video of alleged misconduct in a public place surfaced online. He added that a departmental inquiry has also been ordered.

However, Sub-Inspector Anil Gupta has denied the allegations. He claimed that he had only tried to discipline the youth after finding him playing cards and said he made him stand in the “murga” position in front of family members to warn him against criminal activities.

He also rejected allegations of bribery, calling them baseless, and alleged that he was being targeted as part of a conspiracy by police station staff. Gupta further made allegations against Station House Officer Ekta Singh and said he would raise the matter before senior officials.

Police said the departmental investigation is ongoing.

#Aligarh #UttarPradesh #BreakingNews #PoliceMisconduct #ViralVideo

articles.title: Woman Allegedly Cuts Off Lover’s Private Parts Days After His Marriage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident has surfaced from Uttar Pradesh’s Hardoi district, where a woman allegedly attacked her boyfriend and severed his private parts after reportedly becoming upset over his recent marriage.

body.html:
A shocking incident has surfaced from Uttar Pradesh’s Hardoi district, where a woman allegedly attacked her boyfriend and severed his private parts after reportedly becoming upset over his recent marriage.

The incident took place in the Pali police station area and triggered panic across the locality.

According to reports, the victim, identified as 20-year-old Sudhir Kumar from Gujidei village, got married on May 6 in Jasmai Khirauna village. Police said Sudhir had allegedly been in a relationship with a married woman for the past four years, and she was reportedly angry over his marriage.

On Saturday afternoon, the woman allegedly called Sudhir to meet her near sugarcane fields close to Kurseli village. During the meeting, an argument reportedly broke out regarding his marriage.

Police said the woman allegedly attacked Sudhir with a blade and grievously injured his private parts before fleeing the scene.

The injured man was rushed by his friends to the Community Health Centre in Shahabad, where doctors provided first aid before referring him to the district hospital for advanced treatment.

The incident caused a sensation in the area after news spread among villagers.

According to police, the accused woman belongs to the Balamau area, while her in-laws reside in the Sawaijpur region.

Additional Superintendent of Police Alok Raj Narayan said the woman has been detained and is being questioned in connection with the case. He added that the injured youth is currently out of danger.

Police said legal proceedings are underway and further investigation is ongoing.

#Hardoi #UttarPradesh #BreakingNews #CrimeNews #ShockingIncident

articles.title: BJP Yuva Morcha Leader Shot Multiple Times Outside Home in Lucknow
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: BJP Yuva Morcha leader Chetan Tiwari (30) was critically injured after an assailant allegedly opened fire on him in Lucknow on Saturday night, in an attack captured on CCTV cameras.

body.html:
BJP Yuva Morcha leader Chetan Tiwari (30) was critically injured after an assailant allegedly opened fire on him in Lucknow on Saturday night, in an attack captured on CCTV cameras.

The incident took place around 8 pm in the Mehndiganj area under Bazar Khala police station limits, when Chetan was standing outside his house.

According to police, the accused arrived on foot carrying a pistol and suddenly opened fire at close range. CCTV footage shows the attacker, dressed in blue jeans and a white shirt, approaching Chetan before firing multiple rounds.

Police said Chetan tried to duck and save himself, but the first bullet struck him in the waist, causing him to collapse on the road. The attacker then allegedly moved closer and fired more shots, hitting him in the shoulder and neck.

The footage also shows nearby women and residents running in panic as the accused allegedly pointed the pistol towards them as well, forcing people to retreat into their homes.

After firing around five rounds, the attacker fled the scene on foot. Locals rushed to help the injured leader, who was seen lying in a pool of blood, and immediately shifted him to KGMU Trauma Centre. His condition remains critical.

The incident triggered tension at the hospital, where supporters and local residents gathered in large numbers demanding the immediate arrest of the accused. Police officials reportedly spent nearly an hour trying to calm the crowd.

Police have identified the accused as Vaibhav Vajpayee (30), a resident of the same locality. He has been taken into custody and is being questioned.

According to investigators, Chetan Tiwari works in hoarding installation, and the attack is suspected to be linked to an old rivalry reportedly related to hoarding disputes.

Meanwhile, a heated argument also broke out between locals and DCP West Kamlesh Dixit at the hospital after some people questioned the police claim that the accused had been detained.

Police said CCTV footage from the area is being examined in detail and investigation is underway from all possible angles.

#Lucknow #UttarPradesh #BreakingNews #BJP #CCTV #Firing

articles.title: BJP District Panchayat Member Among 4 Held in ₹51 Lakh Marijuana Bust in Lucknow
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a major anti-drug operation, the Anti-Narcotics Task Force (ANTF) busted an inter-district marijuana smuggling network in Lucknow and arrested four accused, including a BJP district panchayat member from Mohanlalganj.

body.html:
In a major anti-drug operation, the Anti-Narcotics Task Force (ANTF) busted an inter-district marijuana smuggling network in Lucknow and arrested four accused, including a BJP district panchayat member from Mohanlalganj.

The operation was carried out on Saturday in the BBD police station area by a joint team of the ANTF units from Kanpur and Barabanki.

According to officials, the team intercepted two cars near the canal culvert intersection in front of the Baburiha Power House. During the search, police recovered 103 kilograms of marijuana allegedly hidden inside the vehicles.

Police also seized two cars and seven mobile phones from the accused. The recovered marijuana is estimated to be worth around ₹51.50 lakh in the international market.

The arrested accused have been identified as Jitendra Kumar Jaiswal of Nagaram police station area, Vishal Pandey of Matiyari in Lucknow, Saurabh Jaiswal of Barabanki, and Akhilesh Kumar of Unnao.

Inspector Aynuddin, in-charge of the ANTF Kanpur unit, said the action was conducted on the instructions of senior officials in coordination with the Barabanki ANTF team.

During interrogation, the main accused, Jitendra Kumar Jaiswal, allegedly admitted that he had been sourcing large quantities of marijuana from Bihar and supplying it across Lucknow and nearby districts for a long time.

Police said Jitendra is an elected District Panchayat member from the Mohanlalganj area.

The ANTF later handed over the accused and seized materials to BBD police station, where a case was registered under the NDPS Act.

All four accused were produced before a court and subsequently sent to jail. Police said efforts are underway to identify and arrest other members linked to the smuggling network.

#Lucknow #UttarPradesh #BreakingNews #MarijuanaBust #NDPSAct

articles.title: Bengaluru ‘Hit-and-Run’ Turns Into Murder Plot: Police Uncover Shocking Robbery Conspiracy Behind
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A case initially believed to be a hit-and-run accident in Bengaluru’s Kurubarahalli area has now been exposed as an alleged pre-planned murder and robbery conspiracy following a detailed police investigation.

body.html:
A case initially believed to be a hit-and-run accident in Bengaluru’s Kurubarahalli area has now been exposed as an alleged pre-planned murder and robbery conspiracy following a detailed police investigation.

The victim, Vijayalakshmi, succumbed to injuries suffered in the incident that took place on April 21 on Pipeline Road under the Mahalakshmi Layout Police Station limits.

According to police, the case was first registered as a road accident. However, investigators from Vijayanagar Traffic Police grew suspicious after analysing CCTV footage and examining the crime scene.

The probe, led by Traffic Police Inspector Giriraj along with PSI Rajalakshmi and investigation staff, reportedly uncovered evidence suggesting that the incident was deliberately planned.

Senior officers then involved the Mahalakshmi Layout Police for a deeper investigation. After reviewing multiple CCTV clips and questioning neighbours, police allegedly discovered that the complainant himself was linked to the conspiracy.

Police have arrested five accused identified as Rakesh, Manjunath, Chetan, Pradeep, and Yohan.

Investigators said accused Chetan was known to Vijayalakshmi and had previously borrowed money from her. Police suspect he conspired with the others after learning that she allegedly kept cash and gold ornaments at home.

According to the investigation, accused Rakesh allegedly rammed his motorcycle into Vijayalakshmi intentionally while she was walking on the road. Soon after, the remaining accused allegedly arrived in an autorickshaw pretending to help her and shifted her to hospital.

During the chaos, accused Manjunath allegedly stole the victim’s house keys from her purse and later attempted to enter her residence to commit theft. However, neighbours reportedly became suspicious and questioned him, forcing him to flee after claiming he had come to collect an Aadhaar card.

Police further stated that Rakesh later approached the Vijayanagar Traffic Police Station and filed a misleading complaint claiming an unidentified vehicle had hit the woman and that he had only helped shift her to hospital.

The alleged conspiracy came to light after the house owner filed a separate complaint regarding an attempted theft at Vijayalakshmi’s residence while she was undergoing treatment.

Police said CCTV footage, witness statements, and technical evidence eventually exposed the coordinated plan behind the incident.

In a related development, one of the arrested accused, Manjunath (45), died during treatment at a hospital on May 3. Police said he had been suffering from pancreatic complications, liver-related ailments, and diabetes.

Senior officers clarified that it was not a custodial death and stated that he died due to prolonged illness while under treatment. An Unnatural Death Report (UDR) has been registered, and police are awaiting the post-mortem report.

Bengaluru Police Commissioner Seemant Kumar Singh and other senior officers reportedly appreciated the investigation teams for uncovering the alleged murder conspiracy.

Further investigation is ongoing.

#Bengaluru #Karnataka #BreakingNews #MurderMystery #CrimeNews

articles.title: 17-Year-Old Student Killed After Reckless Thar Reverses Into Group Near College
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 17-year-old college student died and three others were critically injured after a Mahindra Thar allegedly lost control and ran over students in Karnataka’s Raichur district.

body.html:
A 17-year-old college student died and three others were critically injured after a Mahindra Thar allegedly lost control and ran over students in Karnataka’s Raichur district.

The incident took place in Sindhanur town when the students were reportedly returning home after attending college.

The deceased has been identified as Bhumika (17), a resident of Aragonimara Camp in Sindhanur. She died on the spot due to the impact of the collision.

The injured students — Meghana, Maheshwari, and Jahida — were rushed to a private hospital, where they are undergoing treatment. Police said their condition remains critical.

According to preliminary investigation, the driver of the Mahindra Thar allegedly attempted to reverse the vehicle recklessly at high speed, causing it to lose control and move backward into the students walking on the road.

The entire incident was reportedly captured on nearby CCTV cameras, which are now being examined by police as part of the investigation.

Officials said initial findings suggest driver negligence as the primary cause of the accident.

Police from the Sindhanur Traffic Police Station visited the spot, conducted an inspection, and took the driver into custody.

A case has been registered and further investigation is underway.

#Raichur #Karnataka #BreakingNews #RoadAccident #MahindraThar #CCTV

articles.title: ‘Chemically Coloured Cucumbers?’ Viral Katihar Station Video Sparks Panic, 9 Vendors Detained
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking video allegedly showing cucumber vendors colouring pale cucumbers bright green before selling them to passengers at Katihar Junction railway station has gone viral, triggering outrage and swift action by the Railway Protection Force (RPF).

body.html:
A shocking video allegedly showing cucumber vendors colouring pale cucumbers bright green before selling them to passengers at Katihar Junction railway station has gone viral, triggering outrage and swift action by the Railway Protection Force (RPF).

The viral footage, reportedly filmed on platforms 7 and 8 of the station, shows two women allegedly applying a bright green colouring substance to peeled or pale cucumbers before selling them to travellers.

The clip quickly spread across social media after claims emerged that the cucumbers were being chemically coloured to make them appear fresher and more attractive to passengers during train journeys.

Following the video's circulation, RPF officials at Katihar Junction launched an immediate crackdown. According to authorities, nine women vendors, including the woman seen in the viral clip, were detained for questioning.

Visuals from the station showed RPF personnel seizing baskets filled with cucumbers from vendors, while several women were taken into custody for interrogation. Videos from the scene also captured crowded platforms, the station premises, and the DRM office area as the controversy escalated.

RPF officials confirmed that the viral video was genuine and said an investigation was initiated immediately after the footage surfaced online.

An RPF inspector stated that all detained vendors are being questioned regarding the alleged sale of chemically coloured cucumbers to railway passengers.

The incident has sparked serious concerns over food safety and hygiene standards at railway stations, particularly regarding cut fruits and food items sold openly on platforms.

Many social media users expressed alarm over the alleged use of chemical colouring on food meant for public consumption and demanded stricter inspections and continuous monitoring of vendors operating at railway stations.

Others questioned how such practices could allegedly continue inside a major railway station despite heavy passenger movement and the presence of railway authorities.

Passengers have also been urged online to remain cautious while purchasing cut fruits and raw food items during train journeys.
